## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Format check passes
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-remediation-cascade-e2e.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] Fixture sources tests/lib/assert.sh
- [ ] test_fixture_file_exists asserts fixture data files present (dd-1)
- [ ] test_remediation_context_payload_shape asserts payload shape (dd-2)
- [ ] test_cycles_append_schema_per_iteration asserts cycles[] schema per iteration (dd-3)
- [ ] test_loop_terminates_with_replan_escalate asserts terminal REPLAN_ESCALATE on MAX_CYCLES (dd-4)
- [ ] test_no_placeholder_ids_in_dispatch_sequence asserts dispatch sequence uses real IDs (dd-5)
- [ ] Fixture uses mktemp and PATH override
- [ ] Fixture uses jq assertions and append_review_cycle.py --artifact
- [ ] bash tests/scripts/test-remediation-cascade-e2e.sh → PASS
